result.instructions: Tools for TS Facturas, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my issued invoices are not paid yet?"; "List the expenses from October 2026 with their suppliers."; "Add a new customer with VAT number B12345678 and email billing@acme.example.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TS Facturas data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tsfacturas_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tsfacturas_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tsfacturas_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tsfacturas_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tsfacturas_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show the business this API client belongs to: business ID, fiscal name, VAT number and role. Good first call to check the connection. TS Facturas API: GET /v1/auth/info.

tools.name: tsfacturas_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices and sales receipts with status, totals, dates and contact. Filter by status, date range, customer VAT number or paid state. Use the id from here with tsfacturas_get_invoice. TS Facturas API: GET /v1/invoices.

document_type.description: Only this document type (default: all three).

contact_vat_number.description: Only invoices for the contact with this exact VAT number.

serial_code.description: Only invoices with this serial code.

issued_from.description: Issued on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

issued_to.description: Issued on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: tsfacturas_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice or sales receipt with its lines, taxes, totals, contact and status. TS Facturas API: GET /v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: tsfacturas_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List customers and providers (contacts) with fiscal name, VAT number and contact details. Filter by exact VAT number or customer/provider role. TS Facturas API: GET /v1/contacts.

vat_number.description: Only the contact with this exact VAT number.

tools.name: tsfacturas_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expenses (purchase documents) with identifier, date, contact, lines and totals. Filter by date range, identifier, paid state or supplier VAT number. TS Facturas API: GET /v1/expenses.

identifier.description: Only the expense with this identifier.

contact_vat_number.description: Only expenses from the contact with this exact VAT number.

issued_from.description: Issued on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

issued_to.description: Issued on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: tsfacturas_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments with date, amount, method, direction (income or expense) and the contact or accounting account. Filter by direction, method, date range, contact or account. TS Facturas API: GET /v1/payments.

method.description: Only payments made with this method.

operation_from.description: Dated on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

operation_to.description: Dated on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

contact_id.description: Only payments for this contact ID.

accounting_account_id.description: Only payments for this accounting account ID.

tools.name: tsfacturas_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a customer or provider (contact) in the business. Writes a new record to the business books. TS Facturas API: POST /v1/contacts.

vat_number_type.description: Type of the VAT number, for example NIF.

vat_number.description: Fiscal identification, for example a Spanish NIF.

tools.name: tsfacturas_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: Create a product or service in the business catalogue with its tax key and prices. Writes a new record to the business books. TS Facturas API: POST /v1/products.

tax_key.description: Tax key in the format TAXTYPE_INT, for example "IVA_21" (Spanish VAT 21%).

selling_price.description: Selling price, without VAT. TS Facturas calculates it when omitted.

retail_price.description: Selling price with taxes and discounts. TS Facturas calculates it when omitted.

tools.name: tsfacturas_create_payment
tools.title: Create payment
tools.description: Record a payment in the business books: income received or expense paid. Give exactly one of contact_id or document_id. Writes a new record. TS Facturas API: POST /v1/payments.

amount.description: Amount of the payment, in the business currency.

contact_id.description: Contact ID the payment belongs to. Use this OR document_id.

document_id.description: Invoice or expense ID the payment settles. Use this OR contact_id.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with TS Facturas
prompts.description: What you can do with TS Facturas here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: chase_unpaid_invoices
prompts.title: Chase unpaid invoices
prompts.description: List the issued invoices filtered by paid state. Open one invoice to see its lines, taxes, totals and contact.

prompts.name: review_payments_received_and_made
prompts.title: Review payments received and made
prompts.description: List payments by direction, method or date range. Check the contact or account of each payment.

prompts.name: review_expenses_by_supplier
prompts.title: Review expenses by supplier
prompts.description: List the expenses of a period with their identifier, date and totals. Filter them by supplier VAT number.

prompts.name: add_a_new_customer_to_the_books
prompts.title: Add a new customer to the books
prompts.description: Search the contacts by VAT number first. Then create the customer or provider with its VAT number and email.

prompts.name: record_a_payment_received
prompts.title: Record a payment received
prompts.description: Record income received or an expense paid in the books. Link the payment to one contact or one document.
